title: TxDOT's biggest Central Texas projects
subtitle: Estimated cost in millions, from TxDOT's 2027 program release
alt: Bar chart of the four costliest Central Texas projects named in TxDOT's 2027 Unified Transportation Program release: the I-35 University segment at $343.8 million, the I-35 Downtown segment at $343.5 million, an added lane in each direction on SH 130 in Williamson County at $274.5 million, and an overpass at SH 71 and FM 1209 in Bastrop County at $109.8 million
source: Texas Department of Transportation, via KXAN
